title: Two Boys with Donkey Outdoors, 1967 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from June 1967 depicting two young boys standing in a dry grassy field with a donkey. The older boy carefully handles the donkey's halter, while the younger boy stands by wearing a printed Woodcraft Rangers t-shirt. Trees and rolling hills fill the background, capturing a quiet summer moment of youth, outdoor recreation, and interaction with animals.
